notes.title: THE BEST UPDATE OF THE GAME!!!!
notes.content:
THE BEST UPDATE EVER!
IF YOU HAVE PLAYED SLEEPER S9 BEFORE AND FOUND IT VERY FRUSTUATING, ITS FOR YOU!

The game now has easier initial levels...
The game now has an extra option in Options Settings to make you manually jump from coach to coach!
The game now has the feature
THE ULTIMATE FEATURE TO LOOK BACK AT YOUR PREVIOUS COACH!!!!

if you come to S0 now... you can manually go back to the previous coach to find anomalies if you missed....

notes.title: Price Update | Updated Game, Fixed Glitches,
notes.content: the price has been reduced by thrice, after many suggestions, many glitches were fixed.

notes.title: Very Exciting New UI Update!!
notes.content:
I have added a new UI element to the game which you can find in the main menu... you can know about the anomalies that you have passed over... this can help if you are trying to find a particular anomaly or just learn about anomalies after your every playthrough

This can be very exciting and very fun for those who are eager to learn about more anomalies or just find all the anomalies of the game in general

Also added:
Scene fade in/ fade out in main menu

The man in anomaly levels of S8 is no more missing (that made the game too easy for many players)
